Made up of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Zekk]], and the former [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Jagged Fel]], the '''Alema Rar Task Force''' was charged to defeat the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]], who had become a serious adversary for the [[New Jedi Order]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. The [[New Jedi Order]] believed that Alema Rar had been killed on [[Tenupe]] in [[36 ABY]], but Fel, four years later, revealed to the [[Solo family/Legends|Solos]] that Rar had survived with severe mutilation. After Rar made herself public in a [[Duel on Roqoo Depot|duel]] at [[Roqoo Depot]] with the Skywalkers, Fel took action by forming a task force with Jaina Solo and Zekk with the permission of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Despite Fel and Zekk's fights and jealously for Solo, the trio were able to track Rar to the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', a private [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] owned by [[Booster Terrik]], and fought the Dark Jedi, but were unable to apprehend her, as Rar escaped. After [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] was killed, the team put aside bickering between Fel and Zekk, and focused on capturing Rar, the main suspect behind Skywalker's murder.

The team eventually tracked Rar to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], the location of [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]], where the Task Force was involved with the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]'s [[Battle of Ossus (Second Galactic Civil War)|attempt to threaten the New Jedi Order]]. The GAG were able to take Solo's and Fel's weapons to seal their victory, but Zekk was able to dismember their leader, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Salle Serpa]]. After the battle, Solo went ahead to aid the Jedi in their [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|fight]] against Solo's brother, [[Jacen]], at [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], while Fel and Zekk stayed behind on Ossus to secure the Academy. Later, Zekk and Fel were called to Kashyyyk to fight forest fires cause by Jacen's [[Turbolaser/Legends|Turbolaser]] fire on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but when Rar harassed Solo's parents once again, the Task Force once again set their goal back to capture Rar. They tracked her to an [[MZX32905 system/Legends|asteroid]], where Fel was able to complete the Task Force's goal and killed Rar. After her death, the group disbanded, and the trio stayed on good relations with each other, though Zekk was seemingly lost [[Battle of Uroro Station|at]] [[Shedu Maad]].

==History==

===Origins===
Ever since the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Alema Rar]] turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], the [[New Jedi Order]] had marked her off as a dangerous enemy.<ref name="uq">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref> Rar, however, was marked dead following the conclusion of the [[Swarm War]], a conflict involving the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Rar was presumably killed by a [[spidersloth]] on [[Tenupe]], and was thought dead to all but [[Jagged Fel]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] Chiss fighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was disgraced for his actions during the Swarm War.<ref name="sw">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> Fel knew that Rar had survived her encounter with the spidersloth on Tenupe, and had been living in the wilderness of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Rar used the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers she learned from [[Lomi Plo]], the Queen of the [[Gorog|Dark Nest]] to survive, and expanded upon her powers further while she survived on her own on the planet. During his exile from the Chiss due to damages made by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Jedi [[Lowbacca]], Fel researched Rar's abilities and developed a device to counter her mind-wiping abilities.<ref name="tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

During the beginning stages of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Fel disclosed this information to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during his exile from the Chiss on [[Telkur Station]], but was forced to leave the Solos after [[Hapan]] agents ambushed them because of their believed involvement in an assassination attempted on the Hapan [[Queen Mother]], [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]]. After that, Fel went to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he demanded to see Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] under the alias of [[Jagged Fel|Twinsins Thlee]]. There, Fel explained to Skywalker Rar's survival techniques, as well as her memory wiping ability, and Fel's device to counter it. He also introduced to them a security program which would analyze security [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] input to recognize and track Rar; when the Skywalkers explained that she was also using a holocam-disrupting Force technique, he was confident that the program could be adapted to also track the interference caused by the technique. After the presentation, Fel asked the Skywalkers for the resources as a private citizen, because his access to funds and transportation were very limited. Skywalker then assigned Jedi Knights [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Zekk]] to help Fel hunt Rar.<ref name="exile" />

==Members==
===Jagged Fel===
{{Main|Jagged Fel}}
[[File:JagFel.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jagged Fel]]
'''Jagged Fel''', known as '''Jag''' to his friends, was an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who, much like his father, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Baron of the Empire/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], was dedicated to a life of military service and later became the head of state of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> Raised by his father and mother, [[Syal Antilles Fel]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Jagged Fel was raised in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] among the strict and dutiful [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="TNEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Fel entered a military academy in his very early teens<ref name="Red Sky, Blue Flame">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref> and had attained the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] and command of [[Force Spike|three squadrons]] of [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|Clawcraft]] by age eighteen.<ref name="Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> Fel participated in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a war in which the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], later the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], fought against the extragalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]],<ref name="Ruin" /> in which he developed a romantic relationship with the Jedi Knight Jaina Solo.<ref name="Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref> He helped Jaina defend [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] against a Yuuzhan Vong fleet before serving under his uncle in the defense of [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]], where he began a romance with Jaina which would grow intense as the war went on.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

After the Galactic Alliance won the war, Fel led the Chiss war against the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] colonies, in which he was pitted against Jaina. During the [[Battle of Tenupe|final battle]] of that conflict, Jaina's mother shot him down when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attempted to stop the Chiss from unleashing a genocidal weapon against the Killiks.<ref name="sw" /> Fel spent two years marooned in the deadly jungles of [[Tenupe]] before he was rescued. During the war, he had guaranteed the parole of [[Lowbacca]], a Jedi Knight who later returned to combat against the Chiss. This made Fel and his family responsible for all Lowbacca's damages, and when they could not pay, Fel was permanently exiled from the Chiss. He began tracking the last member of the Killik's [[Gorog|Dark Nest]], [[Alema Rar]], and eventually gained Jedi support for his mission, tracking the Dark Jedi Rar in an uneasy partnership with Jaina and her close friend [[Zekk]].<ref name="exile" /> At long last, Fel personally killed Rar and in so doing restored his family's honor.<ref name="fury" /> At the close of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Fel aided the Jedi in defeating [[Darth Caedus]]. During peace negotiations, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] forced the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] of the Imperial Remnant to accept Fel as the Remnant's head of state so that he could keep tight control of the devious moffs and in so doing allow a stable peace settlement.<ref name="invincible" />

===Jaina Solo===
{{Main|Jaina Solo Fel}}
[[File:Jainablue.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Jaina Solo, Sword of the Jedi]]
'''Jaina Solo''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], the twin sister of [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and the older sister of [[Anakin Solo]]. Born to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], she inherited her father's mechanical adeptness and her mother's Force sensitivity, resulting in her eventual training at the [[Jedi Praxeum]].<ref name="hotf">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force]]''</ref> When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Jaina joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military and distinguished herself as a [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilot.<ref name="vp">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> She was constantly on the front lines of battle during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], earning the title of [[Sword of the Jedi]] from her uncle, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="dw">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>

The [[Second Galactic Civil War|crisis of the Second Galactic Civil War]] resulted in a split between her and Jacen due to his increasingly aggressive actions, though she remained active in the Jedi Order.<ref name="bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> Jaina would later be paired up with Jagged Fel and Zekk on a mission to hunt down the renegade [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]]. While they were on the mission, Jaina flirted with Zekk and Fel, though this often resulted with bickering between the two.<ref name="exile" /> The three were able to resolve their differences, and successfully hunted down and killed Rar.<ref name="fury" /> The death of her aunt Mara and the dark deeds of her brother only encouraged her to find a way to stop Jacen, and she began seeking the means to do so through training with her father's ex-arch-enemy, [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> She later killed her twin brother, Darth Caedus, in a lightsaber duel aboard the ''Anakin Solo''.<ref name="invincible" />

===Zekk===
{{Main|Zekk}}
[[File:Zekk_infobox.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Zekk]]
'''Zekk''' was a street-smart, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] orphan from [[Ennth]] who befriended the Solo twins [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]]. After a fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in his teenage years, he trained to be a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="tlo">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref> Zekk would later go on to participate in the offensives against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and [[Gorog|Dark Nest]]. During the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], he and Jaina became [[Joiner]]s and formed a particularly strong mental connection with one another.<ref name="sw" />

As of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Zekk and Jaina were un-Joined but still shared some thoughts. Soon after that they became partners, though Jaina's family thought they were romantically involved. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] he and Jaina participated in the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]] as part of the [[Hardpoint Squadron]].<ref name="betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref> Soon after, he participated in the [[Blockade of Corellia]] under the leadership of Jacen and Jaina.<ref name="bloodlines" /> Zekk later joined forces with Jaina and [[Jagged Fel]] to hunt down the rogue dark Jedi [[Alema Rar]]. Zekk and Jag often bickered for attention from Jaina, though this usually annoyed Jaina.<ref name="exile" /> Zekk mysteriously vanished from the Force during the war's [[Battle of Uroro Station|final battle]]. Jaina, who never felt him die, insisted he was still alive somewhere, and was considered missing in action after the war's end.<ref name="invincible" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alema Rar Task Force, although the group wasn't named, appears in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''. ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', ''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]'', and ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'' of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series of ''[[Star Wars]]'' novels, authored by [[Aaron Allston]], [[Karen Traviss]], and [[Troy Denning]]. The characters themselves were all featured throughout the series, and the group's task of hunting Alema Rar was a major storyline throughout the series.
